pr_body:
Due to recent grammar changes made ( token to no longer be reported by
 its text rather by his internal token name. Due to the use of pushMode,
 the symbol is not treated as a literal rather as a symbol.
To address this, the parser listener looks at the error message and
 changes the message before returning it to the user.

Fix #124145
Relates #123085 #121948

pr_comment: Hi @costin, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Letting the comment here for the record - I couldn't find a way to change the symbol to lexer through the grammar and instead modified the underlying `Vocabulary`, the class ANTLR uses to get the display name for the token.
While it is available as the interface, its underlying implementation is statically initialized based on the constants resulting from the grammar however it does expose its underlying string arrays which I've been able to hook into per the comments.
Obviously this is language specific - no idea how easy it would be to replicate it elsewhere.
The upside is in the future, new symbols can be added by just adding them to the replacement map.
